LESSON: GOVERNMENT AND BUSINESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.2: Government and Business
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Government and Business, part of Entrepreneurship in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important for the Government to get involved in business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Government and Business together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving; learner develops evaluating and decision-making skills when discussing a case

scenario on e- Government services in business.

• Digital Literacy: learner develops the skills of interacting with digital devices when using ICT tools to access and interact

with the e- Government platform in Kenya.

• Citizenship: learner develops social and civic skills when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of

paying taxes in Kenya.

Values:
• Integrity: learner acquires accountability skills when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of paying

taxes in Kenya,

• Social justice: learner learns about the need for government involvement in business to promote fairness and equity across

the society.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Financial Literacy: learner’s financial literacy skills are enhanced when discussing and presenting on types of taxes paid in

Kenya.

• Social Cohesion: learner’s interpersonal relationships are enhanced when brainstorming and presenting on the reasons for

government involvement in business in Kenya.

Link to other subjects:

57

Social Studies: learner enhances knowledge on taxation when discussing the types of taxes.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Digital devices such as smartphones

• Newspapers

• Text books

• Captioned videos

• Supplementary notes
